name: Infomaniak Public Cloud

evidence.vps: 03: IaaS virtual machines on OpenStack; the customer is the sole administrator of the guest OS and apps

line: Provision OpenStack virtual machines and manage their software yourself.

free.text: CHF300 one-time credit; up to 3 months; card and matching phone required

work.math: (CHF 0.0064 + CHF 0.00457) × 730 hours. 100 GB of transfer is listed as free. No backup or load balancer is included. VAT depends on the billing country.
A VM for 730 hours + an IPv4 address. 100 GB of transfer is listed as free, with no request meter. VAT treatment differs across official sources.
The VM and IPv4 address subtotal is CHF 13.5488 a month. The 10 GB volume rate and daily 7-day backup storage are not priced.
